hero.title:
Business Internet at the best price.

Everywhere in Cameroon.
hero.subtitle: Cherryz brings together the offers of the largest operators (Camtel, Orange, MTN and many more) to give you a dedicated, stable connection at up to 50% less. No works. No downtime.

why.title:
One point of contact.

The best networks.

The right price.
why.p1: Cameroonian businesses pay between 90,000 and 180,000 XAF/Mbps/month when they go straight to an operator. Cherryz negotiates with several providers on your behalf and offers you the best solution, from 45,000 to 70,000 XAF/Mbps/month.
why.p2: We are not one more operator. We are your connectivity broker: we analyse your needs, compare the options and deliver the solution that fits best, technically and financially.

We solve a problem.

listen.d: We understand your business, your usage, your constraints.

study.d: Free site visit: technical feasibility analysis.

pricing.d: A transparent price, fitted to your real budget.

deploy.d: Fast installation, without interrupting your business.

followup.d: Dedicated after-sales support, monitoring, fast response.

law.p1: The website and this notice are governed by Cameroonian law, in particular Law No. 2010/021 of 21 December 2010 governing electronic commerce in Cameroon. Any dispute falls under the competent courts of Yaoundé, unless the law provides otherwise.

meta.title: Privacy policy | Cherryz
meta.description: What data Cherryz collects through its forms, why, who it is shared with, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Cherryz only collects the information you enter in our forms, solely to answer your request. The website uses neither advertising cookies nor audience measurement tools.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p2: This policy falls within Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on the protection of personal data in Cameroon.

purposes.title: Why we use it

list.callback: Call you a first time within 24 hours, then prepare your quote within 48 hours, or after the site visit.
list.confirm: Send you an email confirming your request.
list.source: Know where requests come from (originating site, campaign), to improve our communication.

purposes.p1: The quote questionnaire asks for your explicit consent before sending. Your data is never sold, rented or used for marketing without your consent.

access.title: Who has access to it
access.p1: Only Cherryz’s sales and technical team reads your requests. To run the website, we use three technical providers:
access.p2: These providers may be located outside Cameroon. <transfers></transfers>
access.p3: If you follow a WhatsApp, Cal.com, LinkedIn or Facebook link, you leave our website: that service’s privacy policy then applies.

browser.title: Data stored in your browser
browser.p1: While you fill in a quote questionnaire, your answers are kept in your browser (sessionStorage) so you don’t lose them if you reload the page. They don’t leave your device before you send them and are erased when you close the tab.

security.title: Security
security.p1: Exchanges with the website are encrypted (HTTPS). Requests are stored server-side, in a database whose public access is limited to adding new requests: nobody can read them from the website.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You may at any time ask to access, correct or erase your data, or object to its use. Write to <email></email> stating your request; we reply within <rightsDelay></rightsDelay> days.
rights.p2: If you believe your rights are not respected, you may refer the matter to the Personal Data Protection Authority.
